obfuscation_indicators: adequate to meet current and future obligations
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, showing improved profitability largely due to the absence of prior-year legal settlement costs, while hotel revenue, occupancy, RevPAR, and group business declined. Risks include marketable-securities losses, concentration in Comstock stock, dependence on hotel-market recovery and renovation execution, and reliance on estimated property value and future cash flows to support obligations. Management uses moderately optimistic and conditional language regarding liquidity, additional borrowing capacity, and post-construction benefits.
